text: Artificial intelligence is changing how we think about creativity. Today, AI tools can create paintings, compose music, and even write stories or poems. These programs learn from huge amounts of data and then produce something new. However, AI-generated art is very different from human creativity. Humans create from personal feelings, experiences, and imagination. AI simply follows patterns it has learned. While machines can copy a style or mix ideas together, they do not understand emotions or meaning. So AI may be a helpful tool for artists and writers, but true creativity still comes from people.
